discovery.title: Emissions may be leveling off, but the warming outlook remains sobering
discovery.summary: A new UN emissions assessment says global emissions may have plateaued, yet current national pledges still leave the world on a path to substantially exceed the 1.5°C warming goal.
discovery.why_it_matters: The gap between emissions trends and climate targets affects future heat, ecosystems, infrastructure and the cost of adapting to a warmer world.

discovery.title: Ancient skulls are giving the mysterious Denisovans a face
discovery.summary: A study published October 21 used fossils from China to describe shared Denisovan skull features, adding physical evidence to a human relative long known mainly through genetic clues.
discovery.why_it_matters: A clearer picture of Denisovans could reshape how we understand ancient human diversity and the populations that interacted across Asia.
